method: Python 3 calculated all shift-derived values, decoded full-pass5 bodies with Capstone 4.0.2 x86-32 to count exact absolute writes, and calculated every original __text CALL rel32 target.
limit: The stated values are conditional on the preceding page-size store/helper path and successful execution. This does not cover indirect/computed callers, source changes, alias/non-export writers, later overwrites, runtime success, or pmap lifetime.
